arStrings.szText: Unlocked by finding a Forgotten Altar in one of the many dungeons around Sanctuary.

The size of your {c_important}Aura{/c} Effects are increased by {c_random}[SF_3*100|+%|]{/c}.{if:SF_2} Enemies inside your {c_important}Aura{/c} Effects take {c_number}[SF_5*100|+%|]{/c} bonus Critical Strike Damage.{/if}
Increase the Critical Strike Damage by {c_number}[SF_5*100|+%|]{/c} against enemies inside your {c_important}Aura{/c} Effects.
